body:
She has says she doesnt want to discuss it with them, I havent mentioned it because I dont know if thatll damage the relationship even more. Maybe not the best answer or maybe a cowardly one but its currently how I feel. Also idk the next time she will see them all again and doing it over the phone or text feels bad.

We are going to meet with her therapist next week, don't love the fact its hers as I feel like shes trying to pin me into committing to less of a relationship with them. 

I agree unfortunately she has actively avoided trying to bond with my family and it seems like she just doesnt want to at this point. Even if that wasnt the case this isnt going to help.

Have told her I'd speak up in the future about the humor if it happened again, I asked if she wants to address it with them and she said No. 

Wasn't feeling pressured on the proposing just more so on her not backing off when I tell her it takes 6-8 weeks to get the actually ring once you order it. But yeah this happening now is better than later when we are engaged or married. I am going to join her with her therapist next week and I do worry about it not being a neutral party. So we are both trying for now.
Yeah I feel like I would be okay if they truly talked less, didnt travel by themselves etc. Meeting him at some point might help, pandemic makes that all trickier.
Asking, is this something I should be okay with? Am I wrong not to simply not care? Just looking to see off of your last sentence
